recorder.permissionRequired: Microphone permission required to record the child's voice.

settings.loadErrorFallback: Could not load voice list. Default voice remains available.
settings.emptyVoices: No voices available. Your child can use the default system voice.
settings.localOnlyDesc: Runs 100% locally (server + browser), no Google calls
settings.localWithGoogleDesc: Prioritizes local, auto-falls back to Online
settings.missingGoogleKeyHint: If the server does not have a Google Cloud API key configured, ViRead will automatically use Google/Browser Online as a fallback.
settings.previewFailed: Could not play the voice. Please try again or select a different voice.
settings.savedVoiceResetNotice: The previously saved voice is no longer available. ViRead has reverted to the default voice for parent review.
settings.offlineCacheMultiple: Local voice worker is offline. Standalone Wi-Fi mode has pre-generated audio ready for: {voices}; other voices require starting the local worker or enabling fallback below.
settings.offlineCacheSingle: Local voice worker is offline. Standalone Wi-Fi mode has pre-generated audio ready for {voice}; to preview other regional voices live, start the local worker or enable fallback below.
settings.offlineCacheEmpty: Local voice worker is offline and no pre-generated audio is cached on device. Start the local worker or enable fallback below to play sample voices.

playback.unavailable: On-device voice not ready. Please follow the text on screen and tap Retry.
playback.lockedVoiceUnavailableNotice: The selected voice is busy. ViRead will keep the text instructions to avoid switching voices — please tap Retry.
playback.serverFallbackNotice: Selected voice unavailable; using fallback voice.
playback.androidNativeFallbackNotice: Server voice disabled — using Android device voice.
playback.browserFallbackNotice: On-device voice disabled — using browser online voice.
playback.autoplayBlocked: Browser waiting for interaction to enable audio. Tap Listen again.
playback.partialPlayback: Audio interrupted. You can listen from the beginning.

wasm.deviceUnsupported: WASM STT unavailable on this device.
